correctness.rationale: The two-radius-one-ball intersection bound prohibits scales with more than four objects. Complete diameter-two four-point classification using weights one/two proves only star-contained, square, or parity-three-face object sets; the star case has no nonincident omitted-object witness. The deterministic exhaustive checker verifies dimensions two through eight, but no finite test is invoked as an infinite proof.
